message.content:
## Recent developments
* **GPT-6 Cyber Launch & Security Capabilities:** OpenAI launched GPT-6 Cyber in November 2026, an aligned cybersecurity model designed to find and validate vulnerabilities [7]. OpenAI reported that an AI pipeline using its upcoming cyber model dynamically reproduced 1,724 vulnerabilities and generated 948 local privilege escalation (LPE) exploits and 291 information leak PoCs during a 30-hour run [5]. Additionally, OpenAI partnered with Hacktron for its bug bounty program to harden its systems [3].
* **ChatGPT Wallet:** OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Wallet on November 13, 2026, enabling agentic commerce where users can have automated agents complete purchases on their behalf [4]. It is rolling out initially to US ChatGPT Pro subscribers aged 18 and older [4].
* **Enterprise & Cloud Expansion:** OpenAI expanded its enterprise reach by making ChatGPT Enterprise available in the AWS Marketplace (including healthcare and financial services offerings) [8] and bringing its models to Google Cloud [9]. OpenAI also expanded its partnership with ServiceNow to integrate models and agents into workflows [11].
* **Global Advertising Expansion:** In late October 2026, OpenAI announced that ChatGPT Ads expanded to 26 new countries, surpassing 100,000 platform advertisers [12].

## Talking points
* How are enterprise customers adopting the newly launched AWS Marketplace availability for ChatGPT Enterprise and the expanded Google Cloud offerings [8, 9]?
* What are the early adoption metrics and safety guardrails surrounding the newly launched ChatGPT Wallet and agentic commerce [4]?
* How are enterprise workflows responding to the ServiceNow partnership expansion and the integration of automation tools [11]?
* What risk management procedures are in place following the intense capabilities demonstrated by GPT-6 Cyber and its large-scale exploit generation capacity [5, 7]?

## Open questions
* How will the rollout of ChatGPT Wallet handle liability and fraud prevention as autonomous agents execute transactions on behalf of users [4]?
* What impact will the integration of GPT-6 Cyber have on defensive security postures versus automated threat creation given its capability to generate hundreds of exploits rapidly [5, 7]?
* How will data privacy frameworks adapt given OpenAI's updated policies regarding the use of specific session contents to train and improve safety guardrails [1]?
